messages.subject: bym2 simulation
parts:
Hi,
How could I simulate bym2 effects in INLA

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] bym2 simulation
parts:
This is a useful trick, as we can make a model with no data and fixed
hyperpar, and then just sample from the posterior = prior in this case.

You have to add something on the diag to make it non-singular though

data(Germany)
g = system.file("demodata/germany.graph", package="INLA")

formula = Y ~ -1 + f(region,model="bym2",graph=g,
scale.model = TRUE, diagonal = 1E-4,
hyper = list(prec = list(initial = 0, fixed =
TRUE),
phi = list(initial = 0, fixed =
TRUE)))
Germany$Y[] <- NA
r = inla(formula,family="poisson",data=Germany,E=E,
control.compute = list(config = TRUE))

x <- inla.posterior.sample(10, r, num.threads = 1)
fun <- function() return (region)
## each column is a sample
bym2.samples <- inla.posterior.sample.eval(fun, x)
dim(bym2.samples)
